_comment: Life below decks (scripts/aboard.gd): small moments between the hands, picked by who they are. One may happen on a day (chance), each no more than once every cooldown days. a: who it happens to, matched by any of tags (trait tags), traits, skill {name: at least}, green (under 25 or green), sick; b: someone else: friend, feud, green, sick or any. where: sea or port (leave out for either). rum: only with rum aboard. Effects: mood [value, days] (a morale modifier named after the moment), bond (a and b's opinion of each other), teach (a skill b learns from a), opinion (a's opinion of you, remembered as the moment's name). Texts: {a}, {b}, {port}, {ship}. Never he or she: the crew have no set gender.

idle._comment: What a hand with nothing pressing is thinking, by their first known trait that has a line (Aboard.mind).
idle.drunkard: Counting the days to the next rum issue
idle.gambler: Looking for a game of hazard
idle.honest: Doing their work and asking nothing

fiddle.name: A fiddle after supper
fiddle.text: {a} got out a fiddle after supper, and half the watch danced on the forecastle.

shanty.name: A shanty at the capstan
shanty.text: {a} started a shanty at the capstan, and by the last verse the whole watch had it.

teaching.name: Teaching a green hand
teaching.text: {a} spent the dog watch teaching {b} to hand, reef and steer.

gun_drill.name: Gun drill till dark
gun_drill.text: {a} had the gun crews at drill until dark, the way the King's ships do it. {b} learned something, and grumbled about all of it.

letter.name: A letter home
letter.text: {a} had {b} write a letter home for them, to go out with the next ship from {port}.

dice.name: Loaded dice
dice.text: {a} cleaned {b} out at dice. {b} swears the dice are loaded.

cable_tier.name: Asleep in the cable tier
cable_tier.text: {a} got into the rum after the watch and was found asleep in the cable tier.

shore_leave.name: Shore leave
shore_leave.text: {a} came back aboard at dawn from {port} with no shoes and no memory of losing them. The forecastle hasn't laughed so hard in weeks.

prayers.name: Prayers at the mainmast
prayers.text: {a} led a few hands in prayers at the mainmast. Even some of the hard cases bowed their heads.

omen.name: A dead man's candle
omen.text: {a} saw a dead man's candle on the yardarm at midnight, and half the watch won't go aloft.

yarns.name: Yarns in the dog watch
yarns.text: {a} and {b} sat up half the night swapping lies about the sweethearts they'd had in every port.

knife.name: A missing knife
knife.text: {a} and {b} had words over a missing knife. The bosun had to stand between them.

bulkhead.name: A fist through a bulkhead
bulkhead.text: {a} lost at cards to {b} and put a fist through a bulkhead.

carving.name: A bone carving
carving.text: {a} carved a little ship out of a beef bone and gave it to {b}, for no reason at all.

sickbay.name: A night in the sick bay
sickbay.text: {a} sat with {b} in the sick bay through the night, and wouldn't be sent away.

shares.name: Counting the shares
shares.text: {a} has been working out what the officers' shares come to, out loud, in the mess.

nickname.name: A nickname
nickname.text: The forecastle has given {b} a nickname, and {a} made it stick. {b} pretends to hate it.

dolphin.name: Fresh fish
dolphin.text: {a} took a dolphin off the bowsprit with a grains, and the whole mess ate fresh fish for once.

scars.name: How they got the scars
scars.text: {a} told {b} how they came by their scars. It's a better story every time.

aloft.name: Aloft in a squall
aloft.text: {a} went aloft in a squall to clear a fouled line, and the watch cheered when they came down.

hammock.name: A cut hammock
hammock.text: Someone cut down {a}'s hammock in the night. Nobody saw anything.

proud.name: Proud of the ship
proud.text: {a} was heard in a tavern in {port} telling anyone who'd listen that the {ship} is the best ship in the Caribbean.
